name: Health and places
summary: Imports selected fitness, sleep and named-place events from your phone. Keeps detailed records locally; selected summaries may reach your configured cloud model. No proactive messages.

requires.why: Keep the local health database and summaries.
Read only the selected iCloud inbox.
Optionally remove acknowledged files from that inbox after seven days.
Accept authenticated phone deliveries on loopback, optionally forwarded by private Tailscale Serve.
Run the supplied Swift helper with /usr/bin/swift to download pending iCloud inbox files.

settings.label: Get iPhone shortcuts
settings.hint: Download eight signed templates, then configure the destination folder and your private token on your phone.

settings.label: iCloud inbox folder
settings.hint: Absolute path to Shortcuts/Alexia in iCloud Drive. Add this folder to Alexia’s allowed folders first; create events and health subfolders.

settings.label: Phone identifier
settings.hint: Use this same identifier in Send to Alexia.

settings.label: Named places (JSON)
settings.hint: Map identifiers to short labels. Do not include street addresses.

settings.label: Preferred sources (JSON)
settings.hint: Optional metric-to-bundle-identifier mapping. Automatic choice prefers Watch, then iPhone.

settings.label: Enable private direct delivery
settings.hint: Requires both tokens and Tailscale Serve. The listener binds only to this Mac’s loopback interface.

settings.label: Shortcut receiver token
settings.hint: Use at least 32 random characters; paste the same value into your private Shortcut. Changing it revokes the previous token.

settings.label: Hozz receiver token
settings.hint: Use a different token of at least 32 random characters. Hozz Authorization: Bearer followed by this token.

settings.label: Clean acknowledged inbox files after seven days
settings.hint: Enable after setup verification. Only successfully imported files in events and health are removed.

settings.label: Forget selected range
settings.confirm: Forget the selected range and prevent it being imported again?

settings.label: Allow forgotten data to be imported again
settings.confirm: Remove all forgetting rules? Previously forgotten files can return.
